concepts.title: 01 · Arena Desk Web
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: high-fidelity React WEB ADMIN concept for KT Smart Sport Hub, a Pakistani multi-sport venue management product. Render a polished wide landscape comparison board, ideally 3840x2160, with TWO COMPLETE DESKTOP WEB APP SCREENS side by side, labelled Light and Dark, identical content and layout in each treatment. Straight-on flat screenshots, no device hardware, no tilt, no code. Desktop sidebar and roomy multi-column workspace, never phone UI. Concept title above both screens, concise caption below. Main app brand text exactly "KT Smart Sport Hub". Clearly label "REACT WEB ADMIN · CONCEPT · SAMPLE DATA". Shared visual language matches the implemented Flutter Arena Desk admin: warm cream #F5F3E9 and ivory #FFFDF7 light surfaces, forest green #174C36 actions, muted brass #B28C45 for awaiting-payment status; dark mode deep pine #081C14 background and #10271E panels, ivory text and soft mint #A3D9B9. Refined sans-serif typography, large readable numbers, restrained 16px corner rounding, thin separators, subtle consistent custom outline icons. Tasteful real-looking sport photos only when useful, marked illustrative; no emoji, purple, blue, neon, glassmorphism, giant colored icon circles, decorative gradients, excessive empty space or illegible tiny type. Show a coherent navigable admin product, clear primary action, searchable content, theme toggle, Pakistan date "Thu, 29 Oct", user Ayesha, readable PKR currency. Common navigation: Overview, Schedule, Bookings, Venues, Equipment, Payments, Offers, Reports; compact More for users, sports, tournaments, events, fixtures and settings. Differentiate confirmed bookings, awaiting payment and cancelled states with text labels, not color alone. All figures and people are sample data. Do not imply physical occupancy sensors or unimplemented AI predictions. No cropping of app frames or footer.
Concept title: "01 · Arena Desk Web".
Design direction: the closest desktop companion to the selected Flutter Arena Desk. Schedule-first operations workstation. Narrow forest sidebar, quiet title "Your arena, at a glance." Compact KPI strip "24 bookings", "PKR 48,000 collected", "3 awaiting payment". The dominant center is a genuinely readable horizontal daily timetable with hour columns 16:00, 17:00, 18:00, 19:00 and facility rows Padel Court 01, Cricket Nets, Basketball Court. Reserved blocks labelled Ali Khan and Sara Ahmed, brass pending blocks labelled Awaiting payment, unfilled published open cells with clear open labels. No photo hero consuming screen height. On the right a slim arrivals list and attention queue. Top primary button "Add walk-in", secondary "Check entry pass". Small bottom next-bookings list with payment status. The schedule is the main visual anchor, not a generic statistic dashboard. Caption "Best for front-desk scheduling".

Concept title: "02 · Clubhouse Panorama".
Design direction: editorial, photo-led venue overview. Distinctively different from a timetable-first product. Quiet ivory sidebar with a forest active indicator; broad editorial welcome line and a restrained wide dusk padel-court photo banner occupying only the top quarter. Header "Keep every court in play." Below it a three-column grid of beautifully photographed venue cards: padel glass court, cricket nets, basketball floor. Each card uses small metadata for published sessions, next booking time and a simple Manage venue action, never a live occupancy claim. Top strip 24 Bookings, PKR 48,000 Collected, 3 Awaiting payment. Lower left a calm next-arrivals list, lower right a labelled pending-payment list. Primary button "Manage venues", secondary "Add walk-in". Consistent green typography, thin brass rules and elegant generous proportions. Caption "Best for a visual view of the whole club".

Concept title: "03 · Matchday Workspace".
Design direction: efficient split-pane booking workspace, inspired by thoughtful professional mail/calendar applications. Forest sidebar and compact cream horizontal utility bar. A narrow secondary day agenda column beside a broad bookings workspace, with filter pills All / Awaiting payment / Confirmed / Checked in. A clear table of bookings occupies the main area, columns Time, Customer, Venue, Amount, Payment, Entry. Selected row at 17:00 for Ali Khan opens a contextual right-side detail panel "Booking #1084", "Padel Court 01", "17:00–18:00", "PKR 2,000", "Awaiting payment", with restrained button "Review payment" and "View entry pass"; no auto-confirmation of payment. One clear top action "New booking". Thin list dividers, realistic touch/mouse targets and readable density; no photos or card grid. Small summary counts remain at top. Caption "Best for fast booking and check-in work".

Concept title: "04 · Ledger Console".
Design direction: finance-conscious admin dashboard expressed with premium editorial typography and a quiet horizontal top navigation plus a slim secondary sidebar. Dashboard title "A clear view of every payment." Three strong typographic summary panels "Gross receipts PKR 48,000", "Completed refunds PKR 3,000", "Net revenue PKR 45,000"; a small separate "Pending refunds PKR 1,500" liability notice; values arithmetically consistent. Date range controls and Export report. Main center an extremely legible transaction ledger with four sample rows, status badges Paid / Awaiting payment / Refunded, currency aligned right, subdued payment-method labels Cash / Online. Right column a compact action queue for 3 pending payments, 1 refund to review and a few upcoming booking arrivals, preserving operations links. A very restrained small monthly net-revenue bar chart only if it adds clarity, not a decorative hero graph. Primary action "Review payments". Buttons do not claim to collect or refund money automatically. Caption "Best for payment control and reporting".

Concept title: "05 · Venue & Gear Studio".
Design direction: venue-and-equipment operations hub; distinctly different from financial ledger, schedule grid or editorial hero. Rail-style compact forest navigation and a main content header "Ready for the next game." A wide top segmented selector Overview / Venue inventory / Rental desk / Offers, with Venue inventory active and a dropdown "Padel Court 01". Main workspace split 2:1: left a tidy two-column catalogue of equipment cards with small editorial product cutout photographs of a padel racket, a can of padel balls, a cricket bat and football, clear labels "Sample equipment", brand/model lines and material or ball-type fields shown as staff-entered specifications, daily rental rates and availability tied to date range. Right a rental return desk with Awaiting payment, Due today, Returned inspection states, "Review rental" action and a compact damage-inspection note. Small footer list "Offers & discounts" with one code "PLAY20", "20% off", "1 use per customer" and explicit expiry. No invented real manufacturer promises, use "Club sample / Control model" as sample brand text. Primary action "Add equipment"; secondary "View rental desk". Elegant modular sections and useful hierarchy, spacious high-contrast cream and forest, brass only for attention. Caption "Best for venue inventory and rental operations".
